messages:
incident-bot: Pager — high tail latency + increased 5xx rate for hosted inference (us-east) on /v1/chat. Severity S2. Triggered 03:22 UTC. Incident link: https://redwood.ops/incidents/INC-20260315-333

 daniel: I'm primary for this slot but i'm literally on a train leaving in ~10m. WiFi will be spotty. Who can take primary?

 rebecca: I can pick up primary. Where are we seeing errors? Any recent deploys?

 daniel: thx @rebecca. Errors started ~03:18 UTC after a model-worker restart and autoscaler bounce. Logs show repeated OOMs on model-worker-4 (GPU OOM) with "CUDA out of memory while allocating 1.2GiB". Also a routing canary was rolled ~03:10 (variant: quantlite-v2).

 rebecca: Ok. Joining now. I'm secondary @tony? can you shadow and be ready to scale infra?

 tony: Yep, standing by. If we need to spin up extra nodes I can run the scale playbook.

 ops-rotations-bot: Rotation update: @rebecca is now primary for 1766994321 slot. Secondary: @tony. Shadow: none.

 rebecca: Quick checks:
```
# check pod status
kubectl -n inference get pods -l role=model-worker -o wide
# sample request to observe latency
curl -s -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}" -o /dev/null https://us-east.api.redwood/v1/chat -d '{"model":"gptx-3.8","input":"hi"}'
```

 rebecca: Observed 504s and some 500s. GPU usage on model-worker-4 is at 98% before the OOM. model-worker-2/3 look ok.

 support-liaison-bot: Customers affected: lumina-analytics (dedicated) reporting errors, quantify-ai (hosted) reports increased request latency. Notified account teams.

 rebecca: Mitigation plan: 1) temporarily scale model-worker pool +2 nodes (prefer p4d-ish) 2) remove the canary routing to quantlite-v2 (restore to stable) 3) increase per-pod memory limit for model-worker to avoid OOM for now 4) monitor 1m/5m error windows. Executing 1 & 2 now.

 rebecca: Commands executed:
```bash
k-scale infra scale-nodes --pool model-workers --count +2 --type p4d
infractl routing set --service inference --target stable --from canary:quantlite-v2
kubectl -n inference patch deployment/model-worker -p '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"containers": [{"name":"worker","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"28Gi"}}}]}}}}'
```

 daniel: If you need the emergency patch I pushed earlier for mem-reserve, it's in the patch repo: https://redwood.repos/patches/mem-reserve-20260315. It helped in a similar case last month.

 rebecca: Scaling started. Error rate dropping from 6.3% -> 2.1% in last 3m. Latency tail improving.

 tony: Adding: if errors continue after scale we should rollback the routing change for the affected customer prefixes only. I'll stand by to restart the autoscaler and add node labels.

 rebecca: Agree. Also opened INC-20260315-333 and linked runbook: https://redwood.docs/runbooks/gpu-oom-model-worker. Noting potential root cause: memory regression in quantlite-v2 or lower node capacity after recent infra maintenance.

 rebecca: Handoff plan for next 3 hours: primary remains @rebecca (holding), secondary @tony. Actions taken: +2 model-worker nodes, removed routing canary -> stable, patched memory limits on model-worker. Customer status: lumina reporting improved, quantify watching. Follow-ups: revert memory bump to a safe config after post-mortem; consider a canary with explicit mem-limit checks. I'll stay online for 20m then hand to tony if stable.

 daniel: Thanks all. Appreciate the quick swap while I head to the terminal. Safe to proceed with your mitigation.

 ops-rotations-bot: Note: weekend overlap alert — APAC coverage gap at 11:00 UTC tomorrow. If this incident requires extended monitoring past 06:00 UTC, please coordinate with rotations.

 rebecca: adding a quick note to runbook about the exact memory limit that avoided OOM: 28Gi for worker container on gptx-3.8. Also added a troubleshooting snippet for checking GPU reserved memory: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total --format=csv`

 support-liaison-bot: Lumina confirmed degraded requests resolved for now. Quantify will run regression tests and report in 10m.

 rebecca: last check: error rate 0.9% in 1m window, tail latency ~0.55s. I'll handoff to @tony in 20m if stable. Leaving detailed notes in INC-20260315-333.
